sentences.en: I am tired because I walked a long way.
sentences.zh: 我累了，因为我走了很远的路。

sentences.en: It rained, so the ground is wet.
He has a new book. That is why he is happy.
sentences.zh: 他有一本新书，所以他很高兴。

sentences.en: I do not go out because it is cold.
sentences.zh: 我不出去，因为天气很冷。

sentences.en: The child cries because he is hungry.
The weather is bad, so we stay at home.
sentences.zh: 天气不好，所以我们待在家里。

sentences.en: I like this place because it is quiet.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个地方，因为它很安静。

sentences.en: The flowers grow because there is water and sun.
sentences.zh: 花长出来是因为有水和阳光。

sentences.en: She is not hungry, so she does not eat.
The road was long. That is why he came late.
